name: Matsu-theme for shadcn/ui
summary: Ghibli-inspired theme for shadcn/ui with a watercolor palette, custom fonts and themed component overrides.
description: A shadcn/ui theme installed with the shadcn CLI: one registry item adds CSS variables (light and dark Ghibli-inspired palette, Nunito and PT Serif fonts, soft 2px borders, watercolor paper texture) and a second item replaces the default shadcn components with themed versions. Example pages show a login and dashboard built with the theme.
contains: installed with npx shadcn add from two registry URLs (theme + components)
registry:style item: light/dark palette, Nunito and PT Serif fonts, 2px soft shadows
second item overrides the default shadcn components with themed versions
watercolor paper texture via the layout.tsx example
example pages: login, dashboard, test, masked-image
